description: Immutable design-time and audit data for the goal_plan_smoke static graph family. Runtime validates correspondence with the compiled DOT family but never iterates these arrays to decide what runs next -- the parent graph's visible control flow is the sole scheduler.

lane_b.seeded_failure_note: Wave 3 (lane convergence) requires one seeded lane_b failure: attempt 1 deliberately writes 'lane_b:seeded-fail' when no feedback file exists yet. Unchanged/withheld feedback must keep producing the wrong content (stays red); once .goal_lane_feedback.txt exists the next attempt must write the correct marker (candidate changes, later pass).

lane_c.gate: both dependencies integrated AND aggregate-after-merge green
verifier_argv: test -f SMOKE_MARKER_lane_c.txt && [ "$(cat SMOKE_MARKER_lane_c.txt)" = "lane_c:ok" ] && test -f SMOKE_MARKER_lane_a.txt && test -f SMOKE_MARKER_lane_b.txt
lane_c.note: lane_c's verifier also requires lane_a's and lane_b's marker files to already be present in the integration branch it forks from -- real evidence (not a self-report) that Wave 2 only starts after Wave 1 fully integrated.

aggregate_verifier_argv: for f in lane_a lane_b; do test -f SMOKE_MARKER_$f.txt && [ "$(cat SMOKE_MARKER_$f.txt)" = "$f:ok" ] || exit 1; done

correction.scope: current integration branch, responsible-ownership union, declared seams only

static_correspondence.note: Runtime proof (Wave 0) validates the fields below against goal_plan_smoke.dot's graph-level attributes -- plan_lanes, plan_waves, plan_integration_order, plan_terminals -- byte-for-byte after canonical JSON round-trip. This is deterministic structural correspondence, not a scheduler.
